description: Order a custom research brief on your topic ($1.50 USDC per brief). Topics must be in our lanes: stablecoins, RWA/tokenization, DeFi, the AI agent economy, crypto markets. The brief is researched on demand (up to ~60 min); use check_brief_status to poll for it (polling is free). First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

topic.description: Research topic, 10-200 characters, e.g. 'USDe depeg risk factors'

name: request_brief
